title: How Can a 400-Ton Airplane Fly? The Physics of Lift Explained
short_title: How does a 400-ton jet stay in the air? ✈️ #shorts
description:
A fully loaded jumbo jet can weigh around four hundred tons, and yet it takes off every day. How? Four forces, a curved and tilted wing, Newton's third law, air pressure, speed, powerful engines and wings that change shape. Here is the physics of flight, step by step.
